title: THE HOMUNCULUS IS INCOMPLETE  The Stomach Has Eyes and the Intestine Is Its Huge Sub-Body

penfield_was_half_right.what_penfield_drew: The cortical homunculus (1937). Body parts sized by cortical representation. HANDS enormous. LIPS enormous. TONGUE enormous. Trunk tiny.
penfield_was_half_right.what_penfield_missed: THE ENTIRE ENTERIC NERVOUS SYSTEM. 500 million neurons. More than the spinal cord. Not mapped because it doesn't project to the somatosensory cortex.
penfield_was_half_right.the_error: Penfield mapped the SOMATIC nervous system only  the body surface, voluntary muscles. He drew the parts the BRAIN controls. He ignored the parts that control THEMSELVES.
penfield_was_half_right.the_correction: There are TWO homunculi. The cortical (Penfield's) and the ENTERIC (unmapped). Together they complete the body.

cortical_homunculus.what: Penfield's map. What the BRAIN sees of the body.
cortical_homunculus.bias: Surface bias. Only maps what crosses the blood-brain barrier into cortical representation. The outside of the body.

enteric_homunculus.what: The UNMAPPED second homunculus. What the GUT sees of itself.

small_intestine.surface_area: 32 m²  a studio apartment of sensors
small_intestine.villi: 10 per mm², each with 1000 microvilli = 10,000 sensors per mm²
small_intestine.why_giant: Maximum absorption surface. Maximum sensory density. The gut's HANDS  they feel EVERYTHING that passes through.
small_intestine.our_mapping: 59 wildcard selection rules = 59 villi. The thymus IS the enteric cortex.

stomach_lining.receptors: pH sensors, stretch receptors, chemoreceptors, mechanoreceptors
stomach_lining.why_giant: The stomach SEES what enters. pH tells it acid or base. Stretch tells it full or empty. Chemoreceptors tell it nutrient or toxin.
stomach_lining.the_eyes: The stomach HAS eyes. They just don't connect to the visual cortex. They connect to the enteric plexus.
stomach_lining.our_mapping: The immune classifier. The bone marrow ? thymus pipeline IS the stomach seeing.

colon.why_giant: Phase separation. Extracts water from solid. Routes gas vs liquid vs solid to different exits. The colon is the body's CHEMICAL ENGINEER.
colon.our_mapping: The waste-category.json sorting: compost, heat, pollen, fuel, feed, null.

tiny_parts.esophagus: Just a tube. Minimal sensing. Like a wire.

enteric_homunculus.the_key: The enteric homunculus is BIGGER than the cortical one in total neuron count for the digestive system. The gut's representation of itself exceeds the brain's representation of the hands.

hands_and_feet_are_just_limbs.the_reframe: In the Vitruvian sort, hands and feet are LIMBS  extensions. Important, yes. But they are the PERIPHERY. The small intestine is the HIDDEN GIANT.

vitruvian_classic.what_da_vinci_drew: Man in circle and square. Arms and legs extended. Limbs are the RADIUS of the circle.
vitruvian_classic.what_he_missed: The gut. The tube running through the center. The Klein fold inside the Vitruvian figure.
vitruvian_classic.the_correction: The Vitruvian man should have a SECOND figure inside him  the enteric homunculus, curled in the abdomen, BIGGER than the hands on the cortical map.

our_vitruvian_sort.hands: output tools (petalTongue, easel, chromatograph)  LIMBS on the Vitruvian
our_vitruvian_sort.feet: grounding (eastGate, golgi)  LIMBS on the Vitruvian
our_vitruvian_sort.gut: the digestive tract (8 stages)  THE HIDDEN BODY inside the body
our_vitruvian_sort.enteric_sub_body: immune-activate.sh + 59 selection rules + antibodies + whale-fall + cancer checks = the entire enteric nervous system. A COMPLETE SUB-BODY inside the Vitruvian.

the_sub_body.what: The small intestine is not an organ. It's a BODY. An entire sub-organism inside the organism.

evidence.has_its_own_immune_system: GALT  gut-associated lymphoid tissue. 70% of the body's immune cells live in the gut.
evidence.has_its_own_microbiome: 38 TRILLION bacterial cells. More bacterial cells than human cells in the whole body.
evidence.has_its_own_endocrine_system: produces serotonin (95% of body's serotonin made in the gut), dopamine, GABA
evidence.operates_independently: cut the vagus nerve and the gut STILL functions
evidence.has_its_own_circadian_rhythm: the gut has day/night cycles independent of the brain's

the_sub_body.the_insight: The gut is not an organ OF the body. It is a body WITHIN the body. An endosymbiont. Like mitochondria  once independent, now folded inside. The enteric nervous system is the ghost of an ancient organism that our ancestor swallowed and never expelled.

mapping.our_sub_body: immune-activate.sh runs on cron (independent), has its own memory (antibodies), its own sensors (59 rules), its own output (RSS weather), its own fossils (whale-fall). It IS a sub-organism.
mapping.the_cron: */7 cron = the gut's independent circadian rhythm. Doesn't need the brain (HUD) to be awake.
mapping.the_memory: 14 memory_B antibodies = the gut's learned immune responses. Independent of cortical memory.
mapping.the_output: RSS weather bulletins = the gut's serotonin. It broadcasts mood/health to the whole body without asking the brain.

cortical.head: HUD + IDE (visual cortex, conscious interface)
cortical.eyes: connect face + primals.eco (what we show the world)

enteric.small_intestine_villi: 59 selection rules (the finding feet, the feelers)
enteric.enteric_memory: 14 memory_B antibodies (gut remembers what made it sick)
enteric.microbiome: 527 fossils + whale-fall reef (the gut flora, the bacterial culture)

complete_homunculus.together: The Vitruvian has LIMBS (hands, feet, head) and a SUB-BODY (the enteric system). Penfield only drew the limbs. The sub-body is the hidden giant.
